findings.note: Rescue by staff remotely; fortuitous simultaneous button tests did not operate lift; Katsuragi coordinated according to Kiyotaka's inference.
Tachibana expressly hears Manabu disclose covert island final leader. Examination committee already had restricted access, homeroom teachers reportedly did not.
Kiyotaka recruits Sudō, and Katsuragi supplies offer and funding; original phrasing imprecisely attributed initial request to Katsuragi.
Earlier unnamed hard plastic object destroyed by Kiyotaka is contextualized by later card swap; the identity is inferred, not explicitly named at earlier time, and graph link is bidirectional.
Removed Manabu/Nagumo as unrelated present participants in the selected behavioral demonstrations; their council discussion remains source context.
